author_ancestry: This author wrote CASE V1/V2 and verifier398acd. These are Source-derived descriptions of the author's tests, not an independent audit of those tests or that checker. The author wrote neither adapterV9 nor Root actuals or the distinct Source peer.

entries.finite_coverage: Two original named axioms, one instantiation license and one generalization; retained parent V7 is compared.
entries.limits: Four generic prototype requests, not all possible tiles or a supplied target proof.
entries.purpose: Compare the previous adapter with both new cache modes on independently assembled generic tile requests.
entries.required_behavior: Cold and repeated cached packets equal the uncached packet in full; a fresh instance starts without a warmed entry.
entries.title: Same complete packets

entries.limits: Exercises declared nested fields and one prototype; does not mutate private cache storage.
entries.purpose: Mutate nested data returned on a miss and a hit, then request the same tile again.
entries.required_behavior: The next packet remains pristine and independently checkable; modifying returned statistics cannot alter later statistics.
entries.title: Returned data cannot poison later packets

entries.limits: Five literal requests; no cryptographic collision is forged or claimed.
entries.purpose: Change the full tile preimage, translation or ordered read offset after another request has been stored.
entries.required_behavior: Each distinct request is a miss with its own insertion and equals ordinary uncached reconstruction.
entries.title: Different full requests stay distinct

entries.limits: Five specific invalid requests; not a complete parser or hostile-input audit.
entries.purpose: Try a wrong marking identity, wrong input epoch, wrong premise list and invalid translations after priming a valid entry.
entries.required_behavior: Both cache modes reject; cached hits, entries and insertions do not increase.
entries.title: Malformed requests cannot reuse a valid entry

entries.limits: A zero-capacity fixture; it does not measure process memory or useful speed.
entries.purpose: Set the allowed entry count to zero and request the same valid tile twice.
entries.required_behavior: Both results equal uncached reconstruction; the memo stays empty and records capacity bypasses.
entries.title: No entry capacity still returns checked tiles

entries.limits: One deliberately tiny byte allowance; does not simulate every allocation failure.
entries.purpose: Give the memo a one-byte payload allowance and request the same valid tile twice.
entries.required_behavior: Both results equal uncached reconstruction; no entry, insertion or hit is recorded.
entries.title: An oversized packet follows ordinary reconstruction

entries.finite_coverage: Parent V7, new uncached and cached adapters; empty, selected, combined and excluded fixtures, plus invalid provided states.
entries.limits: Finite independently assembled states; literal fixture restoration is not an engine rollback or scheduler test.
entries.purpose: Compare full state projections and fresh occupancy, selection, exclusion and remote-formula checks across all three adapters.
entries.required_behavior: A stored prototype sees changed read occupancy and exclusions; conflicting remote formulas and missing or changed explicit zero markings are rejected.
entries.title: Current state remains outside the prototype memo

entries.limits: An injected outer-guard rejection; does not demonstrate that the adapter detects arbitrary executable tampering.
entries.purpose: Make the injected caller Source guard reject a request after a valid entry has been primed.
entries.required_behavior: The exact declared guard exception propagates; no completed hit or insertion is added, and ordinary retry is pristine.
entries.title: Outer Source rejection propagates

entries.limits: The changed caller object is not a newly authenticated marking model; private adapter fields are untouched.
entries.purpose: Mutate the caller-owned marking object after constructing and priming the adapter.
entries.required_behavior: Future packets still use the original frozen marking and pass full reconstruction.
entries.title: Constructor owns its marking copy

entries.finite_coverage: Eight subcases: both cache modes, cold or previously used instances, and first-only or repeated failure patterns.
entries.limits: Read-only bounded frame observation; a repeated pattern stops at its first callback when propagation works. No native-unsoundness or all-interleaving claim.
entries.purpose: Raise an exact callback ValueError while the authenticated request-clone helper is active.
entries.required_behavior: The identical exception object propagates without a completed call, hit or new entry; an ordinary retry is checked.
entries.title: Request-clone errors keep their origin

entries.limits: Tests one schema-list mutation; it does not accept or explore another theory.
entries.purpose: Append an untrusted schema to the actual language theory.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed effective theory

entries.limits: Tests one change from the original empty context; it is not a general context theorem.
entries.purpose: Append an assumption to the actual language context.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed assumption context

entries.limits: Tests one list extension, not every change of parameter scope.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual parameter list while retaining the original binding.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed declared parameters

entries.limits: Tests the derived set separately from the parameter list; no private cache field is written.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual derived parameter set.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed derived parameter scope

entries.limits: Tests one derived-name mutation; it does not change authenticated input bytes.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual set of names collected from the logical input.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed input-name census

entries.limits: Tests one namespace extension; it does not claim equivalence under renaming.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual finite binder-name set.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed binder namespace

entries.limits: Tests the effective restriction set; it does not prove generalization soundness by itself.
entries.purpose: Add a name to the actual set forbidden for generalization.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed generalization restrictions

entries.limits: Tests one name change; no equivalent-hole or renaming theorem is assumed.
entries.purpose: Change the actual distinguished name used in equality templates.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed equality-template hole

entries.limits: This is invalidation of a disposable instance, not a search for the replacement statement.
entries.purpose: Replace the effective target while retaining the original binding.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed effective target

entries.limits: Tests complete frozen-data comparison using one added field; not every policy edit.
entries.purpose: Add an untrusted field to the actual language policy.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed effective policy data

entries.limits: Tests one added declaration field; no replacement declaration is authenticated.
entries.purpose: Add an untrusted field to the actual declaration.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed declaration data

entries.limits: Tests one binding field; original input and Source descriptors are not reauthenticated.
entries.purpose: Replace the language epoch inside the actual binding.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed input epoch

entries.limits: Mutates descriptor data only; no executable file or module is modified.
entries.purpose: Change a byte-length descriptor in the actual mathematical Source map.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; the old cached entry gains no hit or insertion. Restoring the original data returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed mathematical Source binding

entries.limits: Tests the native copy separately from language theory; no new native rule is introduced.
entries.purpose: Append an untrusted schema to the actual checker theory.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native theory

entries.limits: Tests one native-context mutation; it does not add an assumption to an accepted proof.
entries.purpose: Append an assumption to the actual checker context.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native assumption context

entries.limits: Tests the checker tuple separately from the language list and derived set.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual native parameter tuple.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native parameters

entries.limits: Tests the checker set separately from the language restriction set.
entries.purpose: Extend the actual native set forbidden for generalization.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native generalization restrictions

entries.limits: Changes configuration only; the ordinary operational visit counter is never mutated or required to match.
entries.purpose: Increase the actual checker visit allowance.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native visit allowance

entries.limits: Tests configuration invalidation, not exhaustion or the soundness of another depth policy.
entries.purpose: Increase the actual checker depth allowance.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native depth allowance

entries.limits: Tests one resource-setting change, not exhaustive fresh-name generation.
entries.purpose: Increase the actual checker fresh-name allowance.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native fresh-name allowance

entries.limits: The changed context must reject before reuse; this is not permission to extend the actual run budget.
entries.purpose: Change the actual checker deadline on a disposable instance.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed context; no successful old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Exact restoration returns the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed native deadline

entries.limits: A descriptor-data mutation, not authenticated new Source or executable tampering.
entries.purpose: Change a byte-length descriptor in the caller-owned executable Source capsule.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed capsule; no old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Restoring the original capsule permits the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed executable Source capsule

entries.limits: A descriptor-data mutation, not authenticated new Source or executable tampering.
entries.purpose: Change a byte-length descriptor in the caller-owned mathematical Source capsule.
entries.required_behavior: Both modes reject the changed capsule; no old-entry hit or new insertion occurs. Restoring the original capsule permits the pristine packet.
entries.title: Changed mathematical Source capsule

entries.required_behavior: The declared failure propagates; entries, insertions and completed hits stay unchanged, and ordinary retry returns the full pristine packet.

groups.purpose: Compare complete packets and ensure caller-owned mutable data cannot become stored authority.
groups.title: Packet identity and ownership

groups.purpose: A full or disabled memo must retain ordinary checked reconstruction.
groups.title: Capacity fallback

groups.purpose: Occupancy, selected or excluded keys, and remote markings remain checks of the current state.
groups.title: Current-state checks

groups.purpose: A caller Source-custody rejection must propagate before a completed hit.
groups.title: Outer Source guard

groups.purpose: A resource callback exception must propagate as the identical exception object.
groups.title: Request-clone exception origin

groups.purpose: A previously checked packet cannot authorize a changed effective logical context.
groups.title: Effective language authority

groups.purpose: A previously checked packet cannot authorize a changed checker configuration or context.
groups.title: Effective native-checker authority

groups.purpose: An owned Source descriptor change cannot reuse an entry from the original capsule.
groups.title: Source-capsule immutability

groups.purpose: Failed calls cannot publish new operative entries or completed hits.
groups.title: Interrupted calls

shared_limits: Every description states what the Source requires; it is not a statement that the case has run or passed.
Finite fixtures under the original two-axiom language and row-zero plus row-one marking, not a universal proof of cache correctness.
No target proof or search route is supplied. No target theorem, full engine conformance, learned marking, trained RL or speedup is established here.
Ordinary native visit counters may differ across modes and are recorded separately from semantic equivalence.
Root owns execution, authentic Source custody, current native and overall budgets, terminal admission and any public runtime result.
All declared cases must complete for a full suite result. A selected subset or unfinished prefix cannot be reported as full suite PASS.
